items.title: Beyond Kubernetes at Modal: How to Scale 1 Million Concurrent Sandboxes in Seconds
items.blurb: In a recent article, Colin Weld and Connor Adams, staff engineers at Modal, describe how they rebuilt their sandbox infrastructure from the ground up to support millions of concurrent sandboxes and tens of thousands of sandbox creations…
